description.zh:
针对四层应用主机记录的查询类型，支持以下4种类型，默认为精确查询。

- fuzzy：模糊查询。
- exact：精确查询。
- prefix：前缀匹配查询。
- suffix：后缀匹配查询。
description.en:
The query type for the host record of Layer 4 applications. The following four types are supported, and the default is exact match.

- fuzzy: Fuzzy match.
- exact: Exact match.
- prefix: Prefix match.
- suffix: Suffix match.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1。
description.en: The page number for paginated queries. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500。
description.en: The number of entries per page for paginated queries. Valid values: 1-500.
The host record of the Layer 4 application.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: Site ID. You can obtain it by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) API.

title.zh: 查询站点的四层加速应用列表
title.en: Query the list of Layer 4 acceleration applications for a site

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa list-transport-layer-applications --site-id 123456000000 --page-number 1 --page-size 500 --match-type fuzzy --record-name www.example.com --region cn-hangzhou
